summary.headline: The Golf Committee elected a new chair and evaluated funding strategies for an irrigation replacement project now estimated near $1 million.
summary.summary: At its June 2, 2026 meeting, the Southborough Golf Committee elected a new chair following the resignation of the previous chair. Members reviewed the golf course irrigation system project, confronting cost escalation toward $1 million and upcoming Community Preservation Act funding deadlines. The committee also discussed recruiting a fifth member, progressing on Audubon International certification planning, and moving forward with previously approved fencing and tree plantings once expired quotes are updated.

topics.title: Election of committee chair
topics.summary: Following the departure and relocation of the prior chair, the committee held an election to appoint a new presiding officer. Member Tony agreed to step into the role, and the committee voted unanimously to elect him as chair.
key_details: Prior committee chair relocated and resigned from the committee
Tony volunteered to take on the chair position with assistance from fellow members
The vote was approved unanimously by the members present

topics.title: Recruitment for committee vacancy
topics.summary: Members discussed methods to recruit a fifth member to ensure steady quorums and spread the workload. Suggestions included drafting a recruitment announcement for MySouthborough, requesting an announcement at an upcoming Select Board meeting, and reviewing town census records.
key_details: The committee currently has four members and requires a fifth member
A member volunteered to draft a notice for publication on MySouthborough
Select Board Chair Kathy Cook will be contacted to announce the vacancy at an upcoming meeting
An audience member suggested reviewing the annual town census list to identify residents with golf or sports occupations
topics.outcome: Members will submit a notice to MySouthborough and contact the Select Board chair to publicize the opening

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The committee reviewed and approved meeting minutes from March 10, 2026, and agreed to maintain a regular meeting schedule on the second Tuesday of each month.
key_details: Minutes from March 10, 2026 approved unanimously
Noted in the minutes that no documents were submitted at the March 10 meeting
Agreed to hold future regular monthly meetings on the second Tuesday of each month

topics.title: Golf course irrigation project funding and planning
topics.summary: The committee held an extensive discussion on the stalled irrigation replacement project, which has seen projected costs rise from an initial $500,000 to nearly $1 million. Members reviewed Community Preservation Act grant expiration timelines, potential value engineering or phasing options, and an upcoming presentation to the Community Preservation Committee.
key_details: Town Meeting previously appropriated roughly $575,000 to $600,000 in Community Preservation Act funds
Estimated total project costs have escalated to approximately $1 million due to materials and pump station requirements
Golf revolving fund currently holds about $180,000, with roughly $130,000 in additional receipts expected this season
Department of Revenue confirmed revolving funds cannot be used to repay municipal borrowing over time
A formal Community Preservation Act grant application is due June 30, with an informational appearance on June 11
topics.outcome: Committee members will meet June 9 to coordinate preparations for the June 11 Community Preservation Committee meeting and check on grant expiration deadlines
topics.why_it_matters: The irrigation system is the golf course's primary capital project and could require additional taxpayer or Community Preservation Act funding to complete.

topics.title: Audubon International certification and management plan
topics.summary: A liaison reported on drafting criteria for an RFP to hire a consultant for the golf course Audubon International management plan. The Conservation Agent will draft the legal procurement document to solicit quotes from three vendors.
key_details: The project is a joint effort between the Golf Committee and the Open Space Committee
Conservation Agent Melissa Danza will prepare the formal RFP document
Procurement requires soliciting quotes from at least three qualified firms
The consultant will review irrigation specifications against Audubon International environmental standards
topics.outcome: Draft RFP criteria will be circulated to the committee for feedback before formal release

topics.title: Fencing, tree planting, and capital improvements
topics.summary: Members discussed approved perimeter fencing and tree planting projects along the third hole fairway, noting contractor quotes have expired and need re-pricing. The committee also identified cart path and turf repair needs and requested a 3-to-5-year capital project estimate.
key_details: Six Eastern White Pines were approved for planting along the third hole fairway with sign-off from the Tree Warden and Conservation Commission
Committee previously approved up to $30,000 for fencing, but contractor bids have expired after 90 days and require updated quotes
Turf erosion and washouts were noted on hillsides between holes 2 and 3 and hole 9
Committee member Bill will assemble a 3-to-5-year capital project forecast for the golf course by Thursday
topics.outcome: Members will seek updated contractor pricing for fencing and trees through the Town Administrator and compile a multi-year project list

votes.motion: Appoint Tony as chair of the Golf Committee

public_comment.summary: A resident suggested searching the annual town census list by occupation to find residents with golf or sports backgrounds to fill the committee vacancy, and suggested having the Select Board chair announce the opening during a meeting.
A resident reported that state Department of Revenue guidance prevents the town from using golf course revolving fund revenues to service long-term town borrowing for the irrigation project.

upcoming.what: Golf Committee meeting to prepare for CPC presentation
Appearance before Community Preservation Committee regarding irrigation project
Deadline for Community Preservation Act grant application submissions
